# jamfplatform_pro_account_privileges (Data Source)

Lists the privilege strings grantable on this Jamf Pro tenant, categorised into the seven privilege buckets. The catalog is read from an existing account group or account whose privilege set is `Administrator` (which holds every grantable privilege). Use it to look up exact privilege strings for the `privileges` block of `jamfplatform_pro_account` and `jamfplatform_pro_account_group`.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Admin identity and access | Admin account | Read | `accounts` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover the privilege strings grantable on this tenant, to look up exact
# values for an account / account_group `privileges` block.
data "jamfplatform_pro_account_privileges" "catalog" {}

output "all_grantable_privileges" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_account_privileges.catalog.all
}

output "computer_object_privileges" {
  value = [
    for p in data.jamfplatform_pro_account_privileges.catalog.jamf_pro_server_objects : p
    if can(regex("Computers", p))
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `all` (Set of String) Flat union of all grantable privilege strings across every category.
- `casper_admin` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the casper_admin category. Jamf Admin (Casper Admin) application privileges.
- `casper_imaging` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the casper_imaging category. Jamf Imaging (Casper Imaging) application privileges (legacy).
- `casper_remote` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the casper_remote category. Jamf Remote (Casper Remote) application privileges.
- `jamf_pro_server_actions` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the jamf_pro_server_actions category. Action privileges (the UI "Jamf Pro Server Actions" tab).
- `jamf_pro_server_objects` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the jamf_pro_server_objects category. Create/Read/Update/Delete privileges for Jamf Pro server objects (the UI "Jamf Pro Server Objects" tab).
- `jamf_pro_server_settings` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the jamf_pro_server_settings category. Read/Update privileges for Jamf Pro server settings (the UI "Jamf Pro Server Settings" tab).
- `recon` (Set of String) Grantable privileges in the recon category. Recon application privileges.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
